prompt: Professional premium rigid packaging photography, one CONSISTENT product in a strict 3-column 2-row contact sheet, 3:2 overall. Six equal square cells, no borders/captions/text/logo. Cell6 blank. Product Fruit preserve presentation, Shoulder-neck box. A removable lid fits over a raised inner neck, leaving a narrow shoulder band. Paper-wrapped rigid greyboard, Textured uncoated wrapping paper, Coral and midnight blue, Fine foil lines and offset pattern, small symmetrical radial motif. EMPTY insert: one sealed-jar cavity. Cell1 CLOSED full 3/4 hero. Cell2 OPEN: Detached lid rests flat RIGHT of base separated by a wide gap; raised inner neck clearly visible. No hinge. Cell3 closed rear/side same design. Cell4 overhead close view of the SAME empty insert inside base. Cell5 close paper/finish/corner detail. All views same proportions, artwork locations, number and shape of insert cavities. Neutral warm studio, tactile paper, refined controlled lighting. Never a corrugated mailer, tuck carton, dust flaps or shipping box. Realistic separate assembled rigid walls, straight edges, accurate mating footprints and visible paper thickness. Keep complete objects within each cell. No products inside; focus on the packaging. In detachable structures never prop the lid against the base or stand it behind it; rest it flat alongside with a clear empty gap.
reviewNotes: Five views reviewed: opening, cavity layout and material continuity. Physical sampling required.
